spans.s:
APT:
I Fit, suitable: q. v.: उपयुक्तः (क्ता,
 क्तं).
II Inclined, prone:
(1) by शीलः
(ला, लं) in comp.,
a. to forget
विस्मरणशीलः (ला,
 लं);
(2) in some cases by a deriv: a. to break
भङ्गुरः (रा, रं);
a. to fall
पातुकः (का, कं),
not
a. to perish
अविनश्वरः (रा, रं).
III Ready,
prompt: q. v.

APTITUDE:
I Tendency, propensity: expr.
by शीलता or by deriv.:
a. to break
भङ्गुरता: v.
Apt (ii).
II Fitness, Suitableness: q. v.
उपयोगिता।
III Readiness in learning:
of
remarkable a.
तीक्ष्णबुद्धि। (mfn.): v. Sharp.

APTLY:
(1) यथोचितम्;
(2) यथोपपन्नम्: v. Fitly,
suitably.
